edges.reason: Source address parameter flows into the overridden _transfer logic.
Destination address parameter flows into the overridden _transfer logic.
Amount parameter is used for balance updates and event emission.
User-controlled amount is the operand of the fee multiplication/division/subtraction.
Fee arithmetic result is subtracted from amount before the final transfer.
Contract balance is read from the _balances state mapping.
Balance is compared against the threshold to compute canSwap.
swapTokensAtAmount threshold is compared with the contract balance.
canSwap gates the swapping flag write that precedes the external swap.
swapping flag is set before calling the swap and ETH forwarding routine.
_transfer invokes swapAndSendDividends while user transfers are executing.
Full contract token balance is passed as the amount to swap and forward.
swapAndSendDividends calls swapTokensForEth before sending ETH.
Token amount parameter is forwarded into the swap function.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
block.timestamp is used directly as the swap deadline, making execution miner-influenced.
The router/pair external call can re-enter the token contract before state settles.
Swap path array is supplied to the external router call.
ETH is forwarded to the owner right after the swap, before the caller returns.
Recipient of the ETH transfer regains control during the swap routine.
owner() supplies the ETH recipient address inside the swap routine.
